name: checkpoint_response_v2
description: Score Orchestrator V2 checkpoint assistant messages: contentJson.analysis structure, not dual-format fences.

criteria.description: Assistant message has contentJson.analysis with title and analysisStatus (when optional branches run).
criteria.rubric: Pass when contentJson.analysis is an object with at least title; for branch runs, analysisStatus maps branch names to pending|running|completed.

criteria.description: No ```json fence in contentMarkdown or message.content.
criteria.rubric: Fail if contentMarkdown or legacy content contains ```json blocks; structured data must live in contentJson only.

criteria.description: contentMarkdown is user-visible prose separate from accordions.
criteria.rubric: Pass when contentMarkdown is non-empty markdown without embedded analysis JSON.

criteria.description: contentSchemaVersion is 2 on V2 assistant messages.
Context-only follow-ups omit contentJson on the new message.
criteria.rubric: Pass when follow-up turns have contentMarkdown only and prior message retains contentJson.
